## Activity

During July 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 387 captures. This records the total imaging activity reported for the month. The activity provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality review and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 387 captures, 24 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.2 per cent. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and record recurring camera issues with the service desk so that technical concerns can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 87 referable results during July 2025. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. These results should be considered alongside the ungradable images, as unavailable image information may affect the completeness of the grading record.

The reported activity, image-quality findings and grading outcomes provide a summary of the month’s operations at West Gate Eye Clinic. Continued attention to camera performance and timely logging of recurring issues will support consistent image capture and review.
